title: Back to school – what’s the first week been like?

content.text: It’s that time of year again… teachers across England are starting to welcome their pupils back to school. But with lots of new protective measures in place, this year it feels a bit different. We asked teachers on social media to share their experiences of what their first week has been like for them…
